predecessors.name: County of Anjou
predecessors.text: Anjou and Maine, the same polygon as the Angevins row

successors.name: Angevin Empire
successors.text: Anjou, Maine and Touraine, joined to Normandy in the Angevin Empire row from 1147

rulers.name: Geoffrey V Plantagenet
rulers.title: Count of Maine (1126), of Anjou and Maine (from 1129), Duke of Normandy (from summer 1144)

ledger.x: 1126: Geoffrey Plantagenet is Count of Maine, and of Anjou from 1129.
1135: Geoffrey backs Matilda's entry into Normandy after Henry I's death, opening the Anjou-Normandy war for the Norman lands west and south of the Seine.
14 January 1144: Geoffrey crosses the Seine and enters Rouen, and takes the title Duke of Normandy in the summer of 1144 ('on 14 January 1144, he crossed the Seine and entered Rouen').
1146: the Angevins' land continues unchanged as the Angevin Empire row from 1147.

wars.name: The Anarchy (Geoffrey of Anjou's conquest of Normandy)
wars.outcome: Geoffrey secured Normandy west and south of the Seine in 1142-1143, entered Rouen on 14 January 1144 and took the duke's title in summer 1144; he ceded the duchy to his son Henry in 1149 (Louis VII ratified it in 1150).

certainty.note: A county's approximate outline from Cliopatria; no page gives a boundary.
